label: Educated
benefit: You have one additional tag skill.
penalty: When you fail a skill test using a skill other than a tag skill, the GM gains 1 AP.

label: Fast Shot
benefit: If you take a second major action in combat and use it to make a ranged attack, the additional major action only costs 1 AP (rather than 2).
penalty: You cannot benefit from the Aim minor action.

label: Gifted
benefit: Choose two S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes and increase them by +1 each.
penalty: Your maximum number of Luck points is one fewer than your Luck attribute.

label: Heavy Handed
benefit: Your Melee Damage bonus increases by +1 DC.
penalty: Your melee and unarmed attacks suffer a complication on a 19 or 20 (rather than only a 20).

label: Small Frame
benefit: You may re-roll 1d20 on all AGI tests which rely on balance or contortion.
penalty: Your carry weight is 150 + (5 × STR) lbs. rather than 150 + (10 × STR) lbs.
